answer: An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The garden counter is kept in vertex and ocean makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1992 identities would post 1528 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
